entities.name: Bennie Bracks
entities.description: Elf druid and zoologist-to-the-stars of New Capenna, dealer of rare creatures to the Cabaretti.

entities.name: Cabaretti
entities.description: Crime family Bennie works with unofficially.

entities.name: Jinnie Fay
entities.description: Jetmir's adopted daughter whose review made Bennie's birds famous.

entities.name: Rocco
entities.description: Cabaretti figure whose kitchen receives some creatures.

entities.name: Mezzio
entities.description: Rooftops where Bennie kept pigeons as a kid.

entities.name: Park Heights
entities.description: Place whose traders and keepers noticed Bennie's birds.

events.summary: As a kid Bennie keeps pigeons on the Mezzio rooftops and dreams of a green world.
events.quote: he was a kid keeping pigeons on the forever-dusk rooftops of the Mezzio

events.summary: Jinnie Fay's glowing review makes Bennie and his birds a success.
events.quote: Bennie and his birds had made it

events.summary: Bennie branches out into exotic pets, becoming the Cabaretti's first-choice dealer.
events.quote: he is their first-choice dealer for rare and beautiful creatures

relations.note: Works with them though not officially affiliated.
relations.quote: Bennie is not officially affiliated with the Cabaretti
